definitions.explanation: A formal telegram sent to express condolences upon someone's death. A customary practice in Japan when one cannot attend a funeral in person.

examples.japanese: {弔電|ちょうでん}を{送|おく}る。
{葬儀|そうぎ}で{弔電|ちょうでん}が{読|よ}まれた。
examples.english: Condolence telegrams were read at the funeral.

examples.japanese: {遠方|えんぽう}のため{参列|さんれつ}できず、{弔電|ちょうでん}を{打|う}つことにした。
examples.english: Since I was too far away to attend, I decided to send a condolence telegram.

notes:
Composed of {弔|ちょう} (mourning) + {電|でん} (telegram). Like {祝電|しゅくでん}, condolence telegrams remain an active custom in Japan. They are typically read aloud during funeral ceremonies.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弔電|ちょうでん}を{送|おく}る: to send a condolence telegram
- {弔電|ちょうでん}を{打|う}つ: to send a condolence telegram (lit. "strike")
- {弔電|ちょうでん}を{読|よ}み{上|あ}げる: to read aloud a condolence telegram
- {弔電|ちょうでん}が{届|とど}く: a condolence telegram arrives

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {祝電|しゅくでん}: congratulatory telegram — sent for happy occasions, the opposite
- {弔辞|ちょうじ}: eulogy — a spoken tribute at a funeral
- {香典|こうでん}: condolence money — monetary offering given at funerals
